thread:
marie-partnerships: Heads-up  OrionTech wants to list their Edge Gateway in the marketplace. They have a recent SOC2 report and an independent red-team/pen test. SI (Jordan) is delivering: full scan artifacts, firmware-attestation.pdf, and a signed executive summary. Goal: finish evidence ingest and legal review so we can lift embargo for coordinated announcement Fri afternoon. What exact artifact formats do we need and any redaction rules? @alan-security @nina-legal

alan-security: From security: needed items - SOC2 PDF (with scope page), pen-test exec summary (PDF) that lists high/med/low counts only, full raw scan exports (Nessus/OWASP/ZAP/Trivy) as individual files, and firmware attestation (PDF). For raw logs: they must be transferred via presigned S3 links and covered by an NDA; no customer PII in uploads; obfuscate internal IPs unless necessary. Preferred presign TTL: 432000 (5 days). Include sha256 for each artifact.

sam-engineering: Ingest details: use s3://marketplace-evidence/oriontech/<artifact-type>/<filename>. Filenames should follow: <partner>_<artifact>_<scan-date>. Example: oriontech_pen-logs_2025-04-01.tar.gz. Please include a metadata.json alongside each artifact with keys: source, scanner, scan_date, sha256, artifact_type. We'll run an ingestion lambda that verifies checksums and tags items in the evidence catalog. Multipart enabled for >100MB. Sample presign we can generate: 

```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/oriontech/pen-logs/oriontech_pen-logs_2025-04-01.tar.gz --expires-in 432000
```

Also recommend separated artifacts (summary.pdf, raw-logs.tar.gz, firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.json).

nina-legal: Legal needs an executed NDA or a signed data-handling attestation before accepting raw logs. Public messaging: allowed to state "SOC2 audited" and "penetration test conducted by [vendor]" — do not include exploit details. Retention default: 12 months; if partner requests longer, we'll add to contract. Ask partner to include signer name, title, and signature date on attestation. I'll prepare the evidence-handling addendum and a boil-down of announcement copy.

jordan-si: Got it  I'll produce separate files. Quick Qs: 1) TTL 5 days OK (Alan said 432000) and 2) do you want scan outputs in their native format or consolidated tar gz? We can provide both but that's bigger. Also firmware attestation: do you need notarization, or is partner-signed attestation sufficient?

alan-security: 1) TTL 5 days is fine. 2) Native format preferred for triage; a consolidated tar for archival is fine too. Firmware attestation: partner-signed attestation is acceptable for listing, but note if we later implement runtime verification we may require a signed cert chain or notarized artifact. Include statement whether signing keys are hardware-backed (HSM/KMS) and any cert fingerprints.

marie-partnerships: @jordan-si, please upload: pen-summary.pdf, raw-logs.tar.gz (native exports inside), firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.json. @nina-legal @alan-security confirm no notarization required for initial listing?

nina-legal: Confirmed  partner-signed attestation PDF is sufficient for launch. Ensure we capture the signer's details. I'll DM the addendum template and the high-level announcement language.

marie-partnerships: Timeline: SI uploads by Wed noon; security review Wed afternoon; legal sign-off Thu AM; embargo lift Fri 16:00 UTC. @deploy-bot can you gate the marketplace announcement until legal confirms?

deploy-bot: Hold created on "oriontech-edge-gw-announcement" until 2025-04-11T16:00:00Z or manual release. Reason: awaiting SOC2/pen evidence and legal clearance. :robot_face:

jordan-si: Acknowledged. We'll aim to upload Wed 09:00 UTC and include native + tar.gz. Thanks all.

marie-partnerships: I'll send partner a one-page with upload links, filename policy, NDA link, and the addendum. We'll reconvene if anything blocks. :sparkles:
